appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeNote: System follows your device. It is {mode} now.

builders.title: Builder settings
builders.description: Event helpers that add a slot to your queues.
builders.goblinBuilderHelp: Adds one extra builder slot, the seventh, for buildings.
builders.goblinResearchHelp: Adds one extra research slot in the Laboratory.

activeHours.title: Active hours
activeHours.description: Set the hours you play each day. Queue timelines add a gap when an upgrade finishes outside this window.
activeHours.status: Active from {start} to {end}, on your local clock.
activeHours.none: No active hours set. Every hour counts as active.
activeHours.sameTime: Start and end are the same. Choose two different times, or clear the window.
activeHours.overnight: This window runs overnight, from {start} to {end} the next day.
activeHours.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved.
activeHours.clockChanged: Your clock offset changed. Active hours still cover {start} to {end} on your clock.

storageNote.title: Stored in this browser.
storageNote.body: Clearing the browser data removes your villages. Export a backup now and then.

export.title: Export
export.description: Download every village and your settings as one file.

import.title: Import
import.description: Choose a backup file. You review it before anything changes.

reset.title: Reset all data
reset.warning: Deletes every village and setting in this browser.
reset.confirmBody: This removes {names}. You can undo it for ten seconds.
reset.doneMessageDisconnected: {amount} {count, plural, one {village} other {villages}} removed. Sync is disconnected on this browser.
reset.syncedCopy: Also delete the synced copy in {provider}
reset.syncedOn: Sync stays on. Your other devices lose these villages at their next sync. Export a backup first if you are not sure.
reset.syncedOff: Without this, sync is disconnected on this browser so the next sync cannot bring the villages back.

villages.title: Villages
villages.description: Create, edit, switch and delete villages.

importDialog.title: Review import

errors.notJson: This file is not valid JSON.
errors.playthroughsMissing: This file is not a Clash of Clans Tracker backup. It has no villages list.

importDialog.checks: The file lists {read} villages and {kept} can be read.
importDialog.skipped: {amount} {count, plural, one {entry was} other {entries were}} skipped.

modeNotes.merge: Adds villages that are new and keeps the later copy of a village that exists in both. Your settings and active village stay.
modeNotes.replace: Uses only what is in the file. Villages that are not in the file are removed.

importDialog.undoNote: You can undo the import for ten seconds.

about.summary: A free progress tracker for Clash of Clans. Track upgrades, research, achievements and more across several villages.
about.disclaimer: This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Supercell or Clash of Clans.

region.title: Language and region
region.description: How the app shows text, numbers and dates on this device. These choices are not saved with your villages, not exported and not synced.

language.label: Language
language.hint: The language of the app. Names from the game stay in English.
